meta.title: About Northmark Chimney — Toronto & GTA Chimney Services
meta.description: Northmark is a chimney services company serving Toronto and the GTA: {{site.years_text}}, {{site.count_chimneys}} chimneys, free inspection with photos and the price before any work.

hero.h1: A Chimney Company Built On Doing The Work Properly
hero.p: Northmark is a chimney services company serving homeowners across Toronto and the GTA. One trade, done well: chimneys — cleaned, inspected, repaired and maintained. We explain what we see in plain language, price before we work, and leave every home the way we found it. Or cleaner.

img.alt: Northmark technician repointing a two-flue brick chimney from a ladder on the roof

a1.h2: No Pressure. No Guesswork. No Shortcuts.
a1.p: A chimney is not a place for improvisation. Every visit follows the same discipline: protect the home, do the work properly, show the homeowner exactly what we found, and put it in writing.
a1.p-2: Our work is carried out by a WETT-certified technician — the Wood Energy Technology Transfer certification Canadian insurers and home inspectors recognise.
a1.p-3: Every visit starts with a look — inside the flue with a camera — and you see the photos.
a1.p-4: If something doesn’t need fixing, we say so. You decide what happens next.
a1.p-5: We use quality materials and stand behind them: every job carries a warranty on materials and labour.

a2.p-2: Working across Toronto and the GTA.
a2.p-8: We look first. You get the price on the spot.

a3.h2: What Every Toronto Homeowner Should Know
a3.p: Four things we explain on almost every visit.
a3.h3: Your Chimney Is A Safety System
a3.p-2: It carries smoke and combustion gases out of your living space. When it works, you never think about it.
a3.p-3: It gets in through small gaps — then Toronto’s freeze-thaw cycles do the damage.
a3.p-4: Burning wood leaves it in the flue. Removing it keeps the chimney venting the way it should.
a3.h3-4: Most Problems Can’t Be Seen From The Ground
a3.p-5: A proper look finds small issues while they are still small — and still cheap.
